services.name: Scenic Jet Ski Adventure
services.desc: Marine Wildlife - Jet Ski Adventure 4 Hours About Get ready for a truly once-in-a-lifetime Alaskan experience! Our exciting jet ski tours are half-day adventures that take you through Resurrection Bay. While experiencing Alaska by jet ski, you will be safely guided by a knowledgeable and experienced guide. On our tours, you will travel along the breathtaking landscape. You will have an opportunity to whale watch and view wildlife in this extremely unique way. Whether you are an experienced jet skier or new to the sport, we can help you feel comfortable on the seas! Our ocean safari Ages 16+ • 4 Hours

includes: Safety equipment including drysuits, life jackets, water shoes, and gloves
You will be provided with a semi-dry suit, neoprene boots and gloves (if needed) as well as a helmet and googles.
blurb: Guests captain their own jet skis to explore the rugged and untouched backcountry of Alaska just minutes from Seward. Tours offer spectacular coastal views and opportunities to see marine wildlife. Small, intimate groups are emphasized for a fully immersive experience.
extraNote: If any person is deemed to be under the influence of any substance they will not be allowed to participate in the tour and they will forfeit their payment. · You can cancel your tour 30 days prior to your tour date and receive a 95% refund. · If you cancel within 30-11 days of your tour date we will offer you a 50% refund or a 12-month credit to use on a future tour. · If you cancel within 10 days of your tour date there is no refund. · If we cancel the tour for weather reasons, we will offer to reschedule you for no fee or issue you a full refund. · Gift card sales are final and non-refundable. · What to bring Weather can be very different in Seward than from surrounding areas such as Ancho
